scenario_note: Synthetic CPU-only scenario from Stage 3: 100 hosts, 60-second samples, three days. Not TSBS default, not benchmark evidence.
cost_unit: analytical row, partition and byte PROXIES ONLY
notes: No p95, runtime, throughput, actual network IO, SSTable size or monetary cost is predicted.
Storage proxy omits SSTable overhead, compaction, tombstones, compression, replication, and actual varchar lengths.
Derived groups require canonical input and reference recomputation; this is not a durable Cassandra materializer.
Workload relative_frequency is missing; no aggregated workload cost or weighted score is calculated.
FR/FU/RC/TI from Mozaffari cannot be inferred from sampling interval or EER cardinality.
